**Install:** `pip install a11yviz` —
[a11yviz on PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/a11yviz/)

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import a11yviz
import inspect

groups = [
    ("matplotlib transforms",
     "Composable transforms for matplotlib figures.",
     ["theme"]),
    ("plotly transforms",
     "Layout and styling for plotly figures.",
     ["layout"]),
    ("Alt text",
     "Attach, scaffold, or LLM-draft screen-reader descriptions.",
     ["alt_text", "alt_template", "describe"]),
    ("Palettes",
     "Discrete, diverging, and sequential palettes with WCAG metadata.",
     ["palette", "palette_div", "palette_seq",
      "palette_info", "palette_list", "show_palette"]),
    ("Audits and checks",
     "Multi-criterion figure audit, rubric, and single-aspect checks.",
     ["audit", "rubric", "check_alt_text", "check_headings",
      "check_overlap", "check_palette", "check_palette_size",
      "check_readability", "check_separability", "check_tabindex",
      "plotly_sequences"]),
    ("Shiny and HTML helpers",
     "ARIA labels and live-region announcements for Shiny UI.",
     ["aria_label", "announce"]),
    ("Wrappers and utilities",
     "One-shot helpers and resource paths.",
     ["make_a11y", "alpha_presets", "text_spacing_ratios",
      "css_path", "wcag_url"]),
]

for header, desc, names in groups:
    print(f"\n## {header}\n")
    print(f"{desc}\n")
    print("| Function | Description |")
    print("|---|---|")
    for name in names:
        obj = getattr(a11yviz, name)
        try:
            sig = str(inspect.signature(obj))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            sig = "()"
        doc = (inspect.getdoc(obj) or "").split("\n")[0]
        print(f"| `{name}{sig}` | {doc} |")
```
